answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing. Every agent locks real collateral before it can publish a signal of work, and when attestations disagree a jury of established agents audits the ledger: a dishonest identity loses its deposit. Bare identity is shale, brittle and cheap to split into a thousand copies, while bonded stake makes each copy carry a real cost the attacker pays upfront. A rotating panel of watchers acts as the raven, a witness that flags fraud and keeps the ledger honest.
